samaveda_hymn2.introduction: Hymns dedicated to Indra in the Purvarchika celebrate the king of gods through powerful melodic chants.
samaveda_hymn2.scripture_text: A representative Samavedic hymn passage for Hymn 2, expressing melodic devotion, sacred recitation, and meditative harmony.
samaveda_hymn2.philosophical_explanation: Indra symbolizes the power of consciousness to overcome obstacles and ignorance. The musical celebration of his victories represents the spiritual triumph of knowledge over darkness.
